shared_elements: dense field of carved script signs covering the whole surface
repeated small sign-units of roughly uniform size
inscription filling a vertical stone face without figural imagery
justification: Both surfaces depict nothing but a dense, uninterrupted grid of writing signs laid out in ruled horizontal registers across a large stone face, which is a real but generic correspondence of format rather than of iconography. The sign forms differ completely: A shows large, bulky, rounded cartouche-like blocks with internal curvilinear infill arranged in paired columns, while B shows small, thin, linear signs strung in long uniform lines, and neither shares any identifiable motif with the other.
